item.text: The shell failed before it could read any files, so I’m working from the supplied evidence. The key issue is sustaining the medics and arts operators through artillery pressure; static legality and the verified opening kill establish neither survival nor civilian safety.

I’ve redesigned the outer lanes around armored blockers so both medics can cover each other and the eastern casters. The plan also gives eastern roadblock clearance, the artillery kill, late blocker replacements and western civilian release explicit handoffs. Those remain hypotheses until tested; the preceding static candidate had no simulation result.

The arithmetic and geometry checks found no tile conflicts or deployment-limit violations. Both medics cover each other and both eastern casters; only Ansel directly covers the central blockers. The tightest budget is Lava’s deployment at second 110, which requires Fang and Vanilla to survive and deliver their scheduled DP.
